units.rawText: I've fooled a lot of people by feigning cynicism.
units.displayText: I've fooled a lot of people by feigning cynicism.

spans.text: I've fooled a lot of people by feigning cynicism.

units.rawText: But I've also allowed my true self to sink down into a bottomless abyss... so far down that the sunlight can no longer reach me.
